about: The art bot's queue, in art tracker order (snapshot 2026-11-05). Each prompt costs one generation. Skipped: EN-01 (acquired), BO-05 (found), IC-01/IC-02 (prompts in other tabs), WO-10 (shader). Edit freely: reorder items, change subjects, add items. A prompt's key is <ID>-<n>; keys already in the drafts branch's progress.json are not made again.
